task.description: Produce a backend design artefact for OBS-02 at src/design/obs-02-prometheus-metrics.md. Define complete metrics architecture for GET /metrics in Prometheus text format, including module boundaries, metric registry lifecycle, scrape handler behavior, and non-blocking collection guarantees. Specify the exact metric contracts for bpm_active_instances_total (gauge), bpm_task_completions_total (counter with definition_id label), bpm_event_append_duration_seconds (histogram with explicit bucket strategy supporting p50/p95/p99), bpm_db_query_duration_seconds (histogram with query_type label), bpm_http_requests_total (counter with method/path/status labels), and bpm_http_errors_total (counter with path label for 5xx). Include instrumentation integration points across API routing/middleware, event append flow, DB query execution, and task completion path; define cardinality controls, stale-data behavior during DB outage, and traceability mapping from every OBS-02 acceptance criterion and edge case to concrete design elements. This step is design only and must not modify source code.
acceptance_criteria: Every OBS-02 acceptance criterion maps to explicit design elements
GET /metrics response contract and content-type behavior are fully specified
All required metrics, labels, and histogram bucket strategy are concrete and testable
Non-blocking scrape and DB-outage stale-data behavior are explicitly defined
Instrumentation boundaries for HTTP, DB, event append, and task completion paths are complete
